about: Characters lost in ES2's Big5 conversion (□ in the mudlib), decided one by one (owner, modern fixes II). The importer applies every rule to every imported string before the region overrides; a □ left after them is an open finding. Hand-ported text (skills.json, combat_actions.json, es2_combat_messages.gd) follows the same table.
